integration-flowchart.alt: A flowchart of six questions in order, each with a yes arrow to a technique: basic form after rewriting? basic rules. Inside function whose derivative is a factor? substitution, with new limits. Rational with top degree at least bottom degree? long division first. Quadratic on the bottom with no real zeros? complete the square, then arctan. BC only: a product with a factor that gets simpler when differentiated? integration by parts. BC only: bottom with distinct linear factors? linear partial fractions. If none fits, rewrite and start again.
